overview_description.description:
Advanta Seeds is focused on sustainable agriculture and providing farmers with quality seeds. Access to high-quality seeds, especially to smallholder farmers, is an essential part of the solution to global food security.

Our proprietary technologies develop better quality hybrids and increase crop yield resulting in market leadership across various products in different regions.

Advanta Seeds was established in 2013 in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

product.name: Aphix
product.description: A sorghum hybrid technology providing tolerance to yellow sorghum aphid, reducing the need for multiple insecticide applications.

product.name: igrowth
product.description: A non-GMO herbicide tolerance technology for sorghum that allows the use of imidazolinone herbicides to control weeds pre- and post-emergence.

product.name: Foundation Farm
product.description: A farming innovation hub in Southern Queensland that integrates agronomy, research, technology, and products to improve farm operations.

product.name: Fortia
product.description: A platform providing farmers with knowledge to optimize meat production per hectare in livestock and mixed farming systems.

product.name: Advanta Innovation Center
product.description: A collaborative space connecting agricultural producers with seed technology innovations and providing technical and business support to smallholder farmers.
